thread:
Becky: Heads up — seeing repeated powercap resets on a couple nodes in eu-west1-gpu-pool (rack r12). Inference tail latency jumps from 60ms to 600ms.
infra-bot: [alert] gpu-rt-12.card1: POWER_CAP_RESET event x3 in last 12m. ECU=apc-ap8959 pdus: r12-pdu2
Raj: Which cards? any Xid errors in dmesg? could be thermal -> power throttle or PDU glitch.
Mike: nvml shows card0 power_limit=200W, card1 power_limit=0 (fallback). `nvidia-smi -q -d POWER` shows rapid transitions.
Becky: dmesg excerpt:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=0, channel=0x00000000
[ 12346.123456] nvrm: GPU at PCI:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus
```
Jonah: That Xid 79 + "fallen off the bus" typically points to lost power or GPU hang. Any fan RPM anomalies?
Mike: One card reporting fan=0 RPM intermittently. IPMI shows BMC temp spike at the same time. snmpwalk r12-pdu2 shows phase A current spike then drop.
Raj: Could be rack-level power hiccup. APC PDU logs show an upstream breaker re-latch at 02:11:22. We should confirm whether other racks saw same.
Becky: Impact: autoscaler tried to replace pods but drain failed because kubelet marked node NotReady during power events. We had ~15% capacity shortfall for the p3-2 pool for ~7 minutes.
infra-bot: [action] Created incident: INC-2026-233 – "eu-west1 r12 powercap resets affecting inference". Pager duty notified.
Mike: Short mitigation: cordon + drain the affected nodes, move critical inference routes to eu-west1-b spare pool, and enable model-fallback policy to lower-cost variant.
Raj: Commands used:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-12
kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Jonah: For triage: run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,power.draw,clocks.gr --format=csv -i 0,1` and collect `dmesg -T | grep NVRM` and APC logs.
Becky: We should also check BIOS/ILA settings on the host: some HP servers had a "power performance bias" that bumped power limit when CPU+GPU spike. If PDU sag exists, GPU tries to draw then PDU trips.
Mike: Proposed next steps:
- Replace card with sustained fan=0, vendor replacement under warranty.
- Run burn-in stress for 4h on spare node to reproduce.
- Tag nodes in r12 as quarantine until PDUs fully validated.
- Add PDU power-sag alert in monitoring (snmp delta > 15% in 1m).
Raj: Also add a graceful fallback in router: if queue latency > 200ms for >30s, divert to dedicated-reserve pool in another region (costly but avoids user impact).
Becky: I'll file a change to update the node drain runbook with the PDU check and include the `apccli` commands.
Jonah: +1. Also bump infra-bot to create a temporary capacity increase for inference-critical teams while we replace hardware.
infra-bot: [note] Temporary quota increase request submitted to cloud-ops.
Mike: Logging note — capture full `nvidia-bug-report.sh` output from the affected hosts before reboot.
Becky: Thanks all. I'll coordinate hardware replacement and postmortem once we have vendor RMA details. :white_check_mark:
